== Biography ==
Susannah or Rosanna was born in 1850. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-16|Robert Finley Glasgow]] and [[Campbell-48293|Nancy Campbell]]. She passed away in 1853.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-16]] is assessed at 92% (proved). The Faris family account places Rosanna/Susannah in Robert Finley and Nancy Campbell’s family, with the 1850–1853 childhood chronology. The documented recovered gravestone supports Susannah’s identity; the name variation does not require a separate child.

Held citation and associated narrative supports this specific paternal assessment; no original was newly inspected.
